promising  building  block  for  large-scale  sensing  neural  interfaces.  However,  in  order  to
provide reliable tools for neuroscience and biomedical engineering applications, the maturity
of this  technology  must  be  thoroughly  studied.  Here,  we evaluate  the  performance  of 64-
